products.title: KALM Signature Oversized Tee
products.description: A considered oversized essential from KALM Move, finished with KALM’s signature embroidered emblem.
products.longDescription: The KALM Signature Oversized Tee is the first available piece from KALM Move. It is cut in a relaxed unisex silhouette with dropped shoulders and a clean crew neckline, then finished with KALM’s signature embroidered emblem at the chest. Available in Black and White, it is designed as a versatile everyday essential.
products.fitNotes: Oversized unisex fit with dropped shoulders and a relaxed straight silhouette. Choose your usual size for a relaxed fit.
products.fabric: 300gsm cotton with a premium heavyweight feel.
products.care: Wash inside out on a cool cycle. Avoid bleach. Do not iron directly over the embroidered emblem.
products.sizeGuide: Available in S, M, L, XL and 2XL. The tee is designed for an oversized unisex fit; choose your usual size for a relaxed silhouette.
products.deliveryGuidance: Please allow up to 5 working days for dispatch.
products.returnsGuidance: Unworn items in original condition may be returned in line with the KALM Collective returns policy.
